item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01825","case1_error":"Treats each two-dozen set as 12 cups, omitting the factor of two.","case2_error":"Converts an already-ounce subtotal as pounds, then reverses the roles of total fruit and non-peach fruit.","reason":"The first omits a stated quantity factor; the second misassigns units and whole-versus-part roles.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01826","case1_error":"Divides days by remaining words instead of words by days.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written subtraction 418 − 342 as 67 instead of 76.","reason":"The first writes an inverted rate relation; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01827","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 20, but the derivation correctly calculates and rounds to 15 minutes.","case2_error":"Evaluates 32 × 12 as 360 instead of 384.","reason":"The first has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01828","case1_error":"Uses the old $5,000 monthly salary for the new company, ignoring the stated 20% raise.","case2_error":"Provides unsupported final numbers after formulas that imply $675 in weekly earnings.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect salary relation; the second supplies incorrect numbers without showing their calculation after a correct setup.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01829","case1_error":"Reports 22 pies after correctly setting up (56 / 8) + (48 / 6), which yields 15.","case2_error":"Reports $4,600 after correctly setting up (60 × 8 × 14) + 2,500, which yields $9,220.","reason":"Both supply unsupported incorrect final numbers after correct formulas, with no intermediate calculation identifying a specific arithmetic mistake.","judgment":"same"}]}
